753:t_008:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It is an eternity that produces nothing... It is a prison called paradise, where the $$御使い$$s dwell...」

753:t_008:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Sitting there, spending an eternity in idleness, was the sin of the $$御使い$$s.」

753:t_008:11.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「They grew corrupt in the peace they acquired, spending 120 million years without advancing at all. One word sums them up: ugly.」

753:t_008:12.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But I escaped it. And to save every universe, I was reborn as a being surpassing the $$御使い$$s.」

753:t_008:13.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Together with this $$至高神Ｚ$$!」

753:t_008:16.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That belongs to the bygone past... a name that will perish with the old world. It lacks just a little to lead a new world... a future of hope and light.」

753:t_008:17.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The world that began with Alpha should have ended with Omega in this world. But a small catalyst transformed it into Z.」

753:t_008:18.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$至高神Ｚ$$... No name could be more fitting for a god who will first end the world.」

753:t_008:19.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are you seriously accepting the universe's great collapse!?」

753:t_008:20.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I regret it too.」

753:t_008:21.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But the passage of 120 million years produced a universe filled with imperfect life.」

753:t_008:22.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Distorted evolution produced ugly evil gods and ravenous destroyers, while other life failed to attain $$シンカ$$.」

753:t_008:23.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So I agreed with the universe's will and concluded that everything should first return to nothing, then begin again.」

753:t_008:24.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I welcome the universe's destruction with supreme joy.」

753:t_008:25.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What selfish reasoning! You refused to recognize humanity's evolution! You have no right to say such things!」

753:t_008:26.en:
$$シャア$$
「Now I understand...! You feared other humans evolving... attaining $$シンカ$$, and catching up with you!」

753:t_008:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Your joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure all came from self-righteous arrogance! You merely sat on high, intoxicated by your own emotions!」

753:t_008:28.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I accept those words, my beloved ones.」

753:t_008:30.en:
$$クェス$$
「No way...! I thought he'd desperately deny it!」

753:t_008:31.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is because we were weak beings. The $$御使い$$s were a sinful species who stopped pursuing $$シンカ$$ 120 million years ago.」

753:t_008:32.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Indeed, $$サクリファイ$$ denied herself, and $$ドクトリン$$ and $$テンプティ$$ were driven to the verge of defeat by $$ゼロ$$'s life-risking $$ギアス$$...」

753:t_008:33.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And my former self would have been trapped in the barrier you prepared.」

753:t_008:35.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is why I became a being surpassing the $$御使い$$s and affirm my power, my existence... everything that I am.」

753:t_008:36.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am no longer a mere emissary of God... I will not demean myself under the guise of modesty as the $$御使い$$s did.」

753:t_008:37.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I will become a god with my own sense of responsibility and awareness.」

753:t_008:38.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「His smile is like a sun without the slightest cloud...」

753:t_008:39.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I don't sense... even the smallest hesitation in him!」

753:t_008:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is it...! This is exactly it!」

753:t_008:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「They act like they're the greatest and always right! That's why I hate these people!」

753:t_008:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A god!? I can't forgive anyone who can shamelessly say that!」

753:t_008:44.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$... You received the power of the $$黒の英知$$, a fragment of $$太極$$...」

753:t_008:45.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You use any means to achieve your ends and oppose me. Then live as a devil.」

753:t_008:46.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A devil? Fine by me! I'll do anything to defeat you!」

753:t_008:47.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I knew you would say that. But your efforts will be in vain.」

753:t_008:48.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Above all, there is very little time left before this universe ends.」

753:t_008:51.en:
$n
「How can you be so arrogant!? Can you watch every life besides your own perish just because you're a god!?」

753:t_008:52.en:
$n
「Doesn't your heart hurt!? Countless lives will be lost because of your decision!」

753:t_008:53.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Only by enduring that pain... No, because I can endure it, I earn the right to be a god.」

753:t_008:54.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I'm prepared to endure every pain and hardship to truly save the universe, believing that someday it will become joy.」

753:t_008:55.en:
$$シン$$
「Shut up! You just went along with that will of the universe because you could survive!」

753:t_008:56.en:
$$刹那$$
「You are... more distorted than anything else!」

753:t_008:57.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Those who destroyed galaxies out of anger or for fun were the worst, but you do it with joy! You're even worse!」

753:t_008:58.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even those words from you, my beloved ones, cannot sway me.」

753:t_008:59.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I will guide the force that seeks to vanish to collapse the universe, then guide the force that seeks to exist...」

753:t_008:60.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「For that reason, you who are filled with the power of life must depart for the end of the causal horizon here and now.」

753:t_008:61.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「In words you can understand, that means total annihilation.」

753:t_009:1.en:
$$ギミー$$
「So that's the power protecting him!」

753:t_009:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Then we'll just wipe them out!」

753:t_009:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Just you wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll crush you along with that huge thing you're so proud of!」

753:t_009:4.en:
$$桂$$
「We'll defeat you and stop the universe's great collapse! Let's settle this the simple way!」

753:t_009:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...I don't think you're foolish. Having defeated $$ヴィルダーク$$, $$アサキム$$, and $$プロディキウム$$, it's natural for you to get the wrong idea.」

753:t_009:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But what stands before you is the Supreme God. The power of eight $$スフィア$$s and four eternities far exceeds your imagination.」

753:t_009:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「You're already losing your nerve, $$ＡＧ$$! Get on with analyzing the dimensional boundaries!」

753:t_009:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Y-yes! At this rate, the universe will lose the ability to maintain its existence in five minutes, and spacetime will collapse!」

753:t_009:11.en:
$$カグラ$$
「You're saying the universe will perish in five minutes!?」

753:t_009:12.en:
$$アマタ$$
「So we have to defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ before then!」

753:t_009:14.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! Now is the time to stake everything!」

753:t_009:15.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Yes! Now is the time to stake everything!」

753:t_009:16.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Yes! Now is the time to stake everything!」

753:t_009:17.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「His power is unknown...! We don't know what kind of moves he'll use!」

753:t_009:19.en:
$$キラ$$
「We'll do it for all the lives in this universe!」

753:t_009:20.en:
$$万丈$$
「The power of $$カオス・コスモス$$ still remains in this space! We can use $$真化融合$$ too!」

753:t_009:21.en:
$$葵$$
「Then we just have to hit him with all our strength and our machines'!」

753:t_009:22.en:
$$トライア$$
「The attack point is right here!」

753:t_010:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「Break through the small fry around him and concentrate your attacks on that spot!」
